title: Judged run KPIs — kpi.json emitted per run under output/<run>/
description: The two KPIs every check reports: (1) tokens usage, (2) judge-scored response quality. Judged blind against frozen oracles verified outside all arms. Exemplar: output/compare-run-20260802/kpi.json.

subjectSha.description: octocode repo SHA the local build was made from

agentTotals.description: Per suite per arm: runner-reported agent tokens (authoritative when available), tool uses, wall-clock

agentTokens.description: Runner/harness-reported total tokens for the solver agent — the authoritative tokens-usage KPI

cacheReadTokens.description: Cache-aware accounting: MCP schema preamble is typically cache_read after turn 1

surfacePreambleBytes.description: L0: MCP = injected tool-definition chars (paid whether used or not); CLI = sum of --scheme output fetched on demand

turns.description: Assistant turns incl. plumbing turns that produced no answer content

targetTools.description: Octocode tools this question exercises (coverage tracking)

contaminated.description: Control arm scored >=1.0 → excluded from the correctness primary

estTokens.description: bytes/4 approximation; superseded by agentTotals.agentTokens where present

calls.description: Tool invocations spent on this question (fewer at equal correctness = better ergonomics)

rawStdoutBytes.description: CLI arm: raw bytes before jq/head filtering; delta vs bytes = what plumbing saved

toolUsed.description: Trajectory layer: did the arm exercise the question's capabilityPoint tool?

falseConfidence.description: Wrong claim asserted as verified (guardrail: must not increase)

suiteRollups.description: Per suite: meanCorrectness / meanCorrectnessUncontaminated / meanQuality / totalBytes / estTokensFromBytes / falseConfidence per arm + verdict string
